تحيوا (form I)
# تَحْيَوْا (taḥyaw) /taħ.jaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَيَّ (ḥayya) and حَيِيَ (ḥayiya)
# تُحْيَوْا (tuḥyaw) /tuħ.jaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَيَّ (ḥayya)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
